subject: Add Dev Profile in Cargo.toml for debugging
reason: The change only adds a [profile.dev] section to Cargo.toml (opt-level 0, debug 2, debug-assertions true), which merely restates Cargo's default dev-profile settings to aid debugging. No source code, command behaviour, data format, replication or persistence path of the valkey-bloom module changes, and release builds are unaffected entirely. It is a build/CI-only change with no runtime behaviour to exercise, so no scenario is needed.
